name: Lasting Scar
text: Roll d6 for location: 1 neck, 2 hands, 3 eye, 4 chest, 5 legs, 6 ear. Roll 1d6; if it beats your max HP, that is your new max HP.

name: Rattling Blow
text: Shaken and disoriented. Say how you pull yourself together. Roll 1d6; if it beats your max HP, take it.

name: Walloped
text: Thrown down and winded. You are deprived until you rest a few hours. Then roll 1d6 and add it to your max HP.

name: Broken Limb
text: Roll d6: 1–2 leg, 3–4 arm, 5 rib, 6 skull. Once it mends, roll 2d6; if it beats your max HP, take it.

name: Diseased
text: A foul infection sets in. When you recover, roll 2d6; if it beats your max HP, take it.

name: Reorienting Head Wound
text: Roll d6: 1–2 STR, 3–4 DEX, 5–6 WIL. Roll 3d6; if it beats that score, take it.

name: Hamstrung
text: You can barely move until you get real help and rest. Afterward roll 3d6; if it beats your max DEX, take it.

name: Deafened
text: You cannot hear until you find extraordinary aid. Either way, make a WIL save; on a success raise your max WIL by 1d4.

name: Re-brained
text: Something in your mind shakes loose. Roll 3d6; if it beats your max WIL, take it.

name: Sundered
text: An appendage is torn off, crippled, or useless. The Warden says which. Make a WIL save; on a success raise your max WIL by 1d6.

name: Mortal Wound
text: You are deprived and out of action. You die in an hour unless healed. On recovery roll 2d6; that is your new max HP.

name: Doomed
text: You should have died. If you fail your next save against critical damage, you die horribly. If you pass it, roll 3d6; if it beats your max HP, take it.
